verdict.rationale: As Merchant of Record, Polar's docs say it calculates, collects, and remits taxes worldwide and assumes liability for international sales taxes, so tax is handled automatically on transactions. Tax-inclusive versus tax-exclusive pricing is configurable at the organization and price level. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of tax calculation mechanics (jurisdiction coverage, B2B reverse-charge and tax-ID handling, tax shown on invoices), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
